description: This is the main HTML file for a web-based database visualizer interface, including embedded CSS styles and JavaScript code for dynamically fetching and displaying database, table, and data information.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches list of databases and renders them in the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases, reset current selection, and updates UI.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses a database to show its tables, and loads tables when expanded.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches data from a selected table and renders it in a table format.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Renders an HTML table with data, including handling wide content and object values.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Renders individual cell contents, handling nulls, objects, and long strings.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses a cell to show full content or truncated preview.
